newsitem.title: FRANCE: Waigel sees weekend talks at level of officials.
newsitem.headline: Waigel sees weekend talks at level of officials.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Friday that weekend talks aimed at finding an agreement on Europe's "stability pact" would initially be carried out by state secretaries, and European Commission and monetary committee members.
The talks will be held ahead of a meeting of EU finance ministers on Sunday night.
He made no reference however to a monetary committee meeting.
He had been asked whether talks would take place at a ministerial level right from the start.
Asked whether an agreement would be reached on Sunday, Waigel said "we will have an answer maybe Sunday, maybe Monday, maybe next week".
Asked if the summit had been a success, Waigel said it was "a step to success but we have do more".
